title: Herbal Chewy Filipino Goat Meat Kare
description: A hearty and comforting Filipino dish made with tender goat meat, a blend of herbal spices, and served in a rich and creamy peanut sauce, all while being mindful of fodmap-friendly ingredients

ingredients.name: 2 cloves garlic
ingredients.notes: mince the garlic for best flavor

ingredients.name: 1 tablespoon grated ginger
ingredients.notes: grate the ginger to avoid lumps

ingredients.name: 2 cups mixed vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as carrots, potatoes, and green beans

ingredients.name: 1 cup peanut sauce
ingredients.notes: see below for peanut sauce recipe

instructions: Brown the goat meat in a hot pan over medium-high heat, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the herbal oil, peanut butter, garlic, ginger, salt, black pepper, cumin, and coriander to the pan and stir until the oil is fragrant and the peanut butter is melted.
Add the mixed vegetables to the pan and cook until they are tender, about 10 minutes.
Pour in the peanut sauce and stir to combine, bringing the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook for 10-15 minutes, or until the goat meat is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Serve the goat meat and vegetables in individual portions, garnished with chopped cilantro.
To make the peanut sauce, combine 1 cup of peanut butter, 1/2 cup of coconut milk, and 2 tablespoons of soy sauce in a blender or food processor and blend until smooth.
